references.text: Describes how some people receive God's word with joy but lack perseverance when trials come, like the shallow soil in the parable.
Luke's version of the Parable of the Sower gives a parallel description of those who receive the word with joy but fall away in times of trial.
Mark's account of the Parable of the Sower also speaks of those who immediately receive the word with joy but have no root and therefore last only a short time.
Warns against falling away after receiving the word with joy, which mirrors the warning in the Parable of the Sower.
